units.source_text: 这句话就成了大家的结论。
老人一个劲儿地指，一个劲儿地擦，手上连煤烟的痕迹也没有了，放出了像小坠子般的光泽。

en.t: The old man kept pointing and kept wiping, until even the traces of soot on his hands were gone, and they gave off a luster like little pendants.

units.source_text: 实际上这双现成的手，与其说是手，毋宁说是手套更确切。

en.t: In fact, these ready-made hands were more accurately called gloves than hands.
